item.title: Custom Monitoring in Zabbix
item.description: A hands-on Zabbix custom monitoring guide — collect custom metrics such as login user count and free-memory percentage with UserParameter, verify them via zabbix_get, then add items, value mappings, and triggers (including a multi-condition trigger) on the web UI for custom alerting.
